notes:
This update fixes CSV replies whose columns use tabs and stops repeated lines in agent replies. A Welcome Tour explains the main buttons, and the licence screen, setup steps and model list use clearer words. Chats reopen at the start of the last reply.

Privacy: with Search the web off, Auto no longer starts Research on its own, and Research asks you to turn the switch on first. Activating a licence now sends only "Mac" and a short install id, never your computer's name. The privacy list in Settings now names every connection the app can make.

Fixes: a command that fails now shows a cross and its exit code instead of a tick. The local API reports real token counts, so tools like Claude Code can track their context. If your disk is full while you activate, Outlier no longer uses up a seat, and the message says what to do. Prices inside the app match the Black Friday sale.
